data.label: Marne Gorge (current gauge) / Keyneton · Apr–Mar

geography.area_note: Approximate 239 km²: uses the published predecessor-gauge area because DEW describes the gauges as co-located. The two flow records are not merged.

area_sources.title: Australian Rainfall and Runoff, Project 5: Regional Flood Methods, Stage 3 report
Marne Saunders PWRA ecological condition assessment
area_sources.location: Section 3.1, paragraph on gauge record combination
area_sources.supports: Describes A4260529 and A4260605 as co-located gauges. This supports transferring the predecessor area as an approximate proxy, not as an independently surveyed A4260605 area.

public_display.label: Not final
public_display.basis: Project-owner permission for public display; not scientific review or agency endorsement.

limitations: Data-review preview, not a verified rainfall–runoff calibration dataset.
Only periods with every daily numeric value are included; source-grade interpretation remains unreviewed.
Rainfall is a point proxy; flow is observed developed-catchment discharge.
SILO and flow dates retain their exported day conventions; no day-boundary correction is claimed.

Approximate observed runoff is annual gauge flow (ML) divided by adopted upstream area (km²). Approximate 239 km²: uses the published predecessor-gauge area because DEW describes the gauges as co-located. The two flow records are not merged.
No adjustment removes farm dams, water use, channel losses or groundwater contributions. Not an estimate of natural/no-dam runoff.
Unit compatibility permits a visual comparison only. No observed dataset or model parameters have been approved or fitted.
